lines.en: I walk on the forest litter.

My hooves land firmly.

lines.zh: 森林的树影，落在我背上的角。
lines.en: Forest shadow falls on the antlers on my back.

lines.zh: 我从一丛灌木绕到另一丛。
lines.en: I move from brush to brush.
I keep my head down for the antlers.
Hooves press through pine needles.

lines.zh: 我朝阳光比较多的那边。
lines.en: I head for the sunnier side.
A lone bull stands at the forest edge.
I listen to the wood.
A leaf is caught on my antler.

lines.zh: 林子里只有风声，很安静。
lines.en: Only wind in the trees — very quiet.

lines.zh: 森林的鹿群，我站在最前。
lines.en: In the forest herd, I stand at the front.
These forked antlers are not for show.

My herd is nearby.

lines.zh: 鹿群里只有我抬头看你。
lines.en: In the herd, only I lift my head to you.
That stick in your hand.
I have to lower my head to see you.

lines.zh: 林子里的鹿群已经散了。
lines.en: The herd has already scattered.
I'm only looking.

lines.zh: 叶子被我们踩碎了，我从侧面挪开。
lines.en: We crushed the leaves; I shift aside.
We crushed the leaves.
My coat brushed your face.
You stumbled stepping back.
We're wedged between the trees.
You hit hard.
My shoulder knocks the tree trunk.

lines.zh: 我的角在树杈间擦过去。
lines.en: My antlers scrape between the branches.
The wood is quiet now.

lines.zh: 我们的角几乎碰在一起。
lines.en: Our antlers nearly met.
The doe is on the far side of the wood.
It's sturdier than I am.
We stood flank to flank.
We made a mess of the leaves.
Afterwards each back to its herd.
There'll be calves here next year.
Neither of us made a loud sound.
The trees hid us.
I pick up a branch.
There's fallen fruit.

lines.zh: 麋鹿的角，把东西勾住了。
lines.en: My antler has it hooked.
My antlers drop once a year.
I nudged it with a hoof.
Bark crumbs scatter on the ground.
Yours fell on the leaves.
I press it into the leaf mould.

lines.zh: 我这副角，撞回去很实在。
lines.en: These antlers hit back solidly.
The leaves soften in my mouth.

lines.zh: 林子里传来了鹿群的脚步。
lines.en: The herd's hooves sound through the wood.
The herd has scattered. I stay.
My antlers lower and point at you.
The herd is watching you.
You're too close to the calves.
I lower the antlers.
The antlers point your way.
Back off and I won't follow.
I take a shortcut to cut you off.
The smell of blood clings to you.
My hooves drown out the leaves.
You're standing in the open.
There is more than one of us in these trees.
My forehoof paws up the leaf litter.
Did you hear that?

lines.zh: 雄鹿的角，一片林子都挡。
lines.en: A stag's antlers block a whole clearing.
I follow by the tree shadows.
You've reached the stream.
My antlers pass between the trees.
You changed direction twice.

lines.zh: 这一片林子没有别的路。
lines.en: There's no other way through here.
I hear you panting.
The others went the other way.
You're backing toward the stones.
Slow, and the wood will not stop me.

lines.zh: 我的蹄声在叶子上很闷。
lines.en: My hooves are muffled by leaves.

lines.zh: 树影把我的轮廓遮住了。
lines.en: The trees hide my outline.
There's a gully ahead.
Your scent is still there.
I moved upwind of you.
I know this ground.
My antlers drop level with your chest.
I've levelled my antlers.
Only a few steps now.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在叶子上很响。
lines.en: Your steps are loud on the leaves.

lines.zh: 我这副鹿角，一年比一年粗。
lines.en: These antlers thicken year by year.
I drive the antlers into you.
This can throw a person.
You were knocked back.
My forehooves come down.
An antler tine caught you.
You're at the tree line.
That landed on armor.
I step off to clear space.
Leaves flew everywhere.
The herd scatters; only I stay.
I swing my head aside.
That was only a warning.
You are still down in the leaves.
I tore the ground up.
I don't do this often.
My antler tip catches your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你挡住一边，另一边没挡。
lines.en: You blocked one side, not the other.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得树叶都落了。
lines.en: Leaves fell from that impact.

lines.zh: 我往前压了一步，鹿群已经散了。
lines.en: I press one step forward; the herd has scattered.
I come out between two old trees.
The leaves sound under me.
This is good woodland.
The antlers show first.
I steadied and shook myself.
There's a herd in the distance.
There's a new scent on the ground.
I raise my head under the branches.
There's sound by the stream.
I looked deeper into the wood.
The trees are dense here.
The soil is soft under me.

lines.zh: 皮一烧，整片林子都闻得到。
lines.en: Burnt hide carries through the whole wood.
My legs jarred on landing.
Water soaks my coat and I sink.
The blast threw up the leaves.
An arrow in my shoulder; I can't stand straight.

lines.zh: 这股光绕过了我的厚毛。
lines.en: That light went past my coat.
Little grass in winter, so I thin out.

lines.zh: 雷打在角上，我浑身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning hit my antler and I went numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有树，也没有草。
lines.en: No trees, no grass in the void.
